settings.title: Girls Winter Boutique
settings.lead: Winter dresses and layers made for real cold days—soft, flattering, and easy to live in.
settings.image_alt: Model in a cream knit winter dress
settings.story: Girls Winter started with a simple frustration: winter outfits that looked polished but felt stiff, bulky, or fussy. We design dresses, coats, and knits that layer cleanly, move with you, and still look beautiful on grey afternoons.
settings.story_2: Every piece is chosen for touch-first fabrics, true-to-size fits, and hems that sit right over boots. Whether you are dressing for school runs, office days, or dinner out, we want one less decision in the morning—and one more reason to step outside.
settings.quote: “Warmth you can feel. Style you do not have to think about.”
